reviews.title: No “Restore Purchases” link
reviews.text:
I was skeptical to begin with, but I just signed up for a premium subscription through the App Store anyway and if you didn’t create an account with an email address beforehand you don’t get access to the premium features you just purchased without having to submit a support ticket through this company to track down your purchase.

It seems they are trying to get around Apples App Store procedures because every legitimate app I have a subscription for through the App Store has a simple “restore purchases” link that restores what you paid for without having to go through the company’s support system. Good thing I can easily get a refund through Apple without having to deal with the company’s support system. I just don’t see any other reason why they would want you to go through them instead of Apples simplified system of restoring your premium subscription.

reviews.title: White Pages
reviews.text:
When I downloaded this app years ago it was pretty good. I just did an update I’d give this version a ZERO out of 10. I reverse searched a number that called me and ALL the information was blotted out. Why? Because they want me to pay $30 to view it! If I could give this review negative stars I would place them about -100 stars to the negative. Why would anyone in their right mind pay that kind of money to see someone’s name THAT CALLED YOU!!!!?

Update: I did an update on the app and now I would rate the app as a NEGATIVE 10 yes -10. It’s not the white pages. The white pages give you the name address and phone number. This is now PAY PER VIEW.  Yes you search any term it shows you that term and if you want information about it you have to pay. It’s not worth it to do an occasional search for someone. Total TWO thumbs down 👎 👎
